commands:
gh pr diff 1168 | awk '/^diff --git/{in_logs=/ [ab]\/\.prflow\/logs\//} !in_logs' > .prflow/tmp/review/pr-1168/run/diff.patch
echo "=== FILES ==="; grep '^diff --git' .prflow/tmp/review/pr-1168/run/diff.patch
echo "=== LINES ==="; wc -l .prflow/tmp/review/pr-1168/run/diff.patch
echo "=== ADDED(non+++) ==="; grep -c '^+[^+]' .prflow/tmp/review/pr-1168/run/diff.patch

ls /home/runner/work/prflow/prflow/.changeset/*.md 2>/dev/null | head; echo "---"; for f in $(ls /home/runner/work/prflow/prflow/.changeset/*.md 2>/dev/null | grep -v README | head -2); do echo "== $f =="; sed -n '1,8p' "$f"; done

scrub.shapes: GitHub tokens/PATs, Anthropic keys, Bearer Authorization headers, and basic Authorization headers
